title: feat(adr-0087): runtime-export-retired reads literal subpath keys

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0087 门禁的 `runtime-export-retired` 类别现在认包 `exports` 映射里的字面子路径键:`包/子路径#导出`、`包/子路径#类型.成员`、`包/子路径#*`(该键在 HEAD 离开映射、包还在)。子路径入口按 `dist/X.d.ts` 对应唯一的 `src/X.ts` 或 `src/X.tsx` 读;通配键、非 TS 键(`./style.css`)、对不上源文件的键都按名拒绝。ADR-0087 D9 原地加一条修订,自测加 SP 电池 80 例。
- 为什么改:以前只读根入口,子路径上退役的导出只能写 `no-migration-prescription` 并去掉箭头躲检测器,正是 D7 要消除的形态。你在决策卡上选了「A 收窄:只认字面子路径键」(卡上记录 6885400963)。
- 风险与回滚:只动门禁脚本和 ADR 文字,不发布任何包;旧的根入口三种写法行为不变(原有 739 个自测断言全绿)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` 的 `subpathSourceEntry` 与 `verifySubpathRetired`;`parseExportOperand`;ADR-0087 D9 新增的 2026-11-14 修订段。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test`,预期 `✓ ... 819 assertions`。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并(ADR 属 Tier H,需你亲手合并或授权批准)。

## What changes

**`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, category `runtime-export-retired`.**

- `parseExportOperand` splits the operand at the package name (`splitPackageSpecifier`): `@scope/pkg/a/b#X` reads the `./a/b` key, `@scope/pkg#X` the `.` key as before. It returns `subpath` and `specifier` beside the old fields. A subpath with a `*` anywhere is refused by name as a WILDCARD; an empty, `.` or `..` segment is refused; a subpath spelling a TS source file keeps the old "names a FILE" refusal.
- `sourceEntryAt` takes the key. The root branch is unchanged. A subpath key (`subpathSourceEntry`) reads its types entry with `resolveTypesEntry(manifest, './sub')` and maps `dist/P.d.ts` (or a `.d.mts` / `.d.cts` twin) to exactly one of `src/P.ts` / `src/P.tsx`. Refused by name: a key only a wildcard key reaches (`wildcardKeysMatching`, which never resolves the pattern), a key that names no `.d.ts` (`./style.css`), an unmappable key, an ambiguous key, and an absent key (marked `keyAbsent`).
- Export and member operands on a subpath run the three predicates unchanged, through a surface cache keyed by rev, package and key. When the key left the map at HEAD, the refusal names the whole-key spelling.
- `PACKAGE/SUB#*` is new (`verifySubpathRetired`). Predicate 1: the key maps at the base; at HEAD the package is still a workspace member (a deleted one points at `PACKAGE#*`), it declares an `exports` map (a missing field and `"exports": null` are both refused: Node and TypeScript read null as absent), the key is gone and no wildcard key reaches it. Predicate 2: none of the package's own files the key's entry reaches is a metadata surface (a file of another workspace package the entry re-exports is that package's, judged when its name is an export operand), and no metadata surface outside the package names the specifier in code (`packageReference`, shared with `PACKAGE#*`). Predicate 3: one FROM line names the specifier.
- Header comments, the HOW hint and the "deliberately NOT checked" paragraph are updated. New battery `SP (#30598)`, floor 80.

**`docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`, D9, plus one pointer in the 2026-10-12 addendum's opening.** A third amendment note under the unmappable-entry paragraph, in the shape of the two 2026-10-27 notes (provenance, measurement, the three marker forms, the refusals, the three predicates for `#*`). The "What this does not decide" sentence now names the wildcard refusal. The Status line gets an **Amended** entry, and the 2026-10-12 addendum's opening sentence points at the new note.

## Why

Ruling: the maintainer chose A, narrowed, 「A 收窄:只认字面子路径键」, on a decision card at 2026-11-14T22:42Z; the option read 「新增 <pkg>/<sub>#Export、#Type.member、#*;通配键按名拒绝。改门禁并修订 D9,立一张 skills 卡。」 Recorded on the card as comment 6885400963. Analysis: project file `pm-orders/skills/30598-decision-analysis.md`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on this tree (`f068cde8`)** with the new `sourceEntryAt` over every published package's `exports` keys: 110 published packages, 26 declare subpath keys, 78 keys besides `./package.json`. 68 map, 4 are unmappable (`@objectstack/scenarios` `./score`, `./score/full`, `./runner`, `./export`), 5 are not TS (`@objectstack/spec` `./openapi.json`, four `./style.css`), 1 is a wildcard (`@object-ui/i18n` `./locales/*`), 0 ambiguous. This matches the evaluation's 68 / 4 / 5 / 1. `@objectstack/cli/console` maps to `packages/cli/src/console.ts`; `@object-ui/i18n/locales` maps to `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts`; `@object-ui/i18n/locales/zh` is refused through `./locales/*`.
- **The #30511 changeset (PR #30902) is not re-graded**, per the ruling.
- **No skill or reference teaches the operand grammar.** `git grep runtime-export-retired` under `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `content/**` and `AGENTS.md` has no hit, so the order's third surface is empty. The gate's own refusal text (the HOW hint) names the subpath form.
- **A re-export of another package's SUBPATH is still not followed** by the export reader (only a root re-export is). An `export *` of one stays an unresolved star that refuses an absence claim, which is the conservative direction. Not in the ruling's scope.
- **PR #33460** (card #32674) also edits ADR-0087, at the 2026-08-13 addendum's vocabulary paragraph, not D9. It had not merged when this branch was cut; the seat orders the landing.

## Verification

Changed: 2 files. `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY contract-review tier (`docs/adr/**`, no one-line exit). `check-governed-merges --branch`: GOVERNED, Tier H (`docs/adr/**` ×1), 508 changed lines, under 3000. Changeset: none, labelled `skip-changeset`: the diff is `docs/adr/**` and a repo-root `scripts/` gate, and no package's `files[]` ships either.

Local gates at head `6d1f3bce` (round 3, after the at-tier contract review 6886775383; round 2 was `dc3d60c0` merged with `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4` as `92259ce2`). The derived list was taken and run on `6d1f3bce` itself; earlier rounds ran the same 44 families on `dd6bc2a7` and `92259ce2`, all exit 0.

<details><summary>The gate's own self-test: 819 assertions</summary>

With the new code and before the new battery was added, the self-test printed 739 assertions, every existing battery green (the root operands are unchanged). With battery `SP (#30598)` it prints `✓ check-adr-0087-registration --self-test: 819 assertions over real temp git repos`. SP registers 80 cases: G1 to G6 (export, member, whole key, root and subpath in one marker, arrow form, whole key over an entry that re-exports another package's root), R1 to R20 (wildcard reach, wildcard spelling, non-TS key, unmappable key, absent key, still exported, export on a gone key, key still in the map, wildcard at HEAD, package deleted, no `exports` map at HEAD, metadata surface importing the subpath, entry reaching a metadata surface, per-export FROM lines, ambiguous `.ts`/`.tsx`, `"exports": null` at HEAD, no whole-key hint without an `exports` map, a `types` condition naming a TS source, a member hint naming the subpath spelling, the re-exported name refused as an export operand; SP-R17c/d pin a missing `exports` field beside the null case), and unit pins U1 to U9 on the parser, `splitPackageSpecifier` and `wildcardKeysMatching`. One-off mutations, each restored and never committed: the null check back to an undefined-only test reds SP-R16; dropping the own-directory filter on the entry's files reds SP-G6. The gate has no separate `*.test.ts`; `git grep` of its file name in test files has no hit.

</details>
